summary: Solid unit test suite with comprehensive core logic coverage and workflow validation, but gaps in CLI flag testing (--fail-on-unknown, --type, --help not tested) and limited act integration scenarios (only 2 cases). The in-memory fixture approach is clean, mocking is well-designed, and error handling is partially tested. Would catch most regressions in manifest parsing and license checking but could miss edge cases in requirements.txt (URL packages, environment markers), some JSON parsing error paths, and strict-mode behavior with unknown dependencies. Structure is clear and well-organized.
